cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Back Me Up
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to support your version of how an ordinary responsibility should be handled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Tell the manager we agreed I'd cover the morning, not the evening. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then you have no conflicting memory.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you look thoughtfully unsurprised while I explain?
